children: In his new role, Kandari will focus on guest experience, business growth and strengthening the property’s position within Gujarat’s luxury hospitality landscape, with the complex also catering to convention, MICE, wedding and leisure travel

The Leela Palaces, Hotels and Resorts has appointed Pradeep Kandari as General Manager of The Leela Gandhinagar and Mahatma Mandir Exhibition and Convention Centre (MMCEC), bringing more than two decades of hospitality experience to the role.

Kandari has been with The Leela since January 2023, holding progressive leadership roles across its Bengaluru portfolio. Before this appointment, he served as Hotel Manager at The Leela Palace Bengaluru.

Before joining The Leela, Kandari held leadership positions with The St. Regis Mumbai, Starwood Hotels & Resorts, Le Royal Meridien and Taj Hotels Resorts and Palaces. His international experience includes an assignment with Manchester Marriott.

In his new role, Kandari will focus on guest experience, business growth and strengthening the property’s position within Gujarat’s luxury hospitality landscape, with the complex also catering to convention, MICE, wedding and leisure travel.

Pradeep Kandari, General Manager, The Leela Gandhinagar & MMCEC, said, "I am delighted to take on this opportunity. Gujarat is witnessing an exciting evolution in luxury hospitality, driven by the growth of convention, MICE, wedding, and leisure travel across the region.

With The Leela Gandhinagar and the Mahatma Mandir Exhibition and Convention Centre together offering a distinctive proposition for discerning travellers and large-scale events, our focus will be on creating experiences that are warm, intuitive, and memorable, while continuing to uphold the values of Indian hospitality, rooted in the timeless philosophy of Atithi Devo Bhava, that define The Leela."
